continuity.seat_inconsistency_note: one track ID whose attributed seat changed mid-track. This is a proxy for an ID switch, not an ID-switch count: this corpus has no per-person identity ground truth and PRD 1 forbids creating one.

association.note: a high continuity share means most seats came from a track's majority rather than from this frame's geometry, which is a signal to review calibration or detector quality.
